# eScholarship

> eScholarship is the University of California's open-access publishing and institutional repository platform, providing free access to peer-reviewed journals, preprints, and UC scholarship across all ten campuses.

Operated by the California Digital Library, eScholarship supports UC's commitment to open access by hosting scholarly articles, digital archives, and research publications. The platform serves as both a publishing venue for open-access journals and a comprehensive repository for institutional scholarship across diverse disciplines.

## Core Services

- [eScholarship](https://escholarship.org): eScholarship homepage: UC open-access publishing and institutional repository platform
- [About eScholarship](https://escholarship.org/aboutEschol): About eScholarship: mission, services, and role within UC system
- [eScholarship Repository](https://escholarship.org/repository): eScholarship Repository: open-access institutional repository for UC scholarship
- [eScholarship Publishing](https://escholarship.org/publishing): eScholarship Publishing: open-access journal and preprint hosting platform

## UC Campus Collections

- [UC Davis](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucd): UC Davis scholarship repository: agricultural history and economic research
- [UC Irvine](https://escholarship.org/uc/uci): UC Irvine collections: digital archives including Richard Rorty and born-digital works
- [UCLA](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucla): UCLA scholarship repository: biological chemistry and molecular biology research
- [UC Merced](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucm): UC Merced institutional repository: open-access scholarly articles and research
- [UC Riverside](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucr): UC Riverside repository: nanotechnology, biomedical engineering publications
- [UC San Diego](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucsd): UC San Diego collections: marine research, fisheries, coastal resilience studies
- [UCSF](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucsf): UCSF repository: public health, tobacco control, medical humanities research
- [UC Santa Barbara](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucsb): UC Santa Barbara collections: GIS ethics, spatial studies, teaching resources
- [UC Santa Cruz](https://escholarship.org/uc/ucsc): UC Santa Cruz repository: agroecology, organic farming, computational experience

## Policies and Legal Information

- [Site Policies](https://escholarship.org/policies): Site policies: submission guidelines, content standards, peer-review processes
- [Terms of Use and Copyright Information](https://escholarship.org/terms): Terms of use and copyright: licensing, fair use, Creative Commons information
